verses.en: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.pt: Livro da genealogia de Jesus Cristo, filho de Davi, filho de Abraão.
verses.en_web: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: The book of the generations of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

verses.en: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.pt: A Abraão nasceu Isaque; a Isaque nasceu Jacó; a Jacó nasceram Judá e seus irmãos;
verses.en_web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.
verses.en_bbe: The son of Abraham was Isaac; and the son of Isaac was Jacob; and the sons of Jacob were Judah and his brothers;

verses.en: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.pt: a Judá nasceram, de Tamar, Farés e Zará; a Farés nasceu Esrom; a Esrom nasceu Arão;
verses.en_web: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Judah were Perez and Zerah by Tamar; and the son of Perez was Hezron; and the son of Hezron was Ram;

verses.en: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.pt: a Arão nasceu Aminadabe; a Aminadabe nasceu Nasom; a Nasom nasceu Salmom;
verses.en_web: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Ram was Amminadab; and the son of Amminadab was Nahshon; and the son of Nahshon was Salmon;

verses.en: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.pt: a Salmom nasceu, de Raabe, Booz; a Booz nasceu, de Rute, Obede; a Obede nasceu Jessé;
verses.en_web: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Salmon by Rahab was Boaz; and the son of Boaz by Ruth was Obed; and the son of Obed was Jesse;

verses.en: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
verses.pt: e a Jessé nasceu o rei Davi. A Davi nasceu Salomão da que fora mulher de Urias;
verses.en_web: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Jesse was David the king; and the son of David was Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah;

verses.en: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.pt: a Salomão nasceu Roboão; a Roboão nasceu Abias; a Abias nasceu Asafe;
verses.en_web: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Solomon was Rehoboam; and the son of Rehoboam was Abijah; and the son of Abijah was Asa;

verses.en: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.pt: a Asafe nasceu Josafá; a Josafá nasceu Jorão; a Jorão nasceu Ozias;
verses.en_web: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Asa was Jehoshaphat; and the son of Jehoshaphat was Joram; and the son of Joram was Uzziah;

verses.en: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.pt: a Ozias nasceu Joatão; a Joatão nasceu Acaz; a Acaz nasceu Ezequias;
verses.en_web: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Uzziah was Jotham; and the son of Jotham was Ahaz; and the son of Ahaz was Hezekiah;

verses.en: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.pt: a Ezequias nasceu Manassés; a Manassés nasceu Amom; a Amom nasceu Josias;
verses.en_web: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Hezekiah was Manasseh; and the son of Manasseh was Amon; and the son of Amon was Josiah;

verses.en: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.pt: a Josias nasceram Jeconias e seus irmãos, no tempo da deportação para Babilônia.
verses.en_web: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Josiah were Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the taking away to Babylon.

verses.en: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.pt: Depois da deportação para Babilônia nasceu a Jeconias, Salatiel; a Salatiel nasceu Zorobabel;
verses.en_web: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.
verses.en_bbe: And after the taking away to Babylon, Jechoniah had a son Shealtiel; and Shealtiel had Zerubbabel;

verses.en: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.pt: a Zorobabel nasceu Abiúde; a Abiúde nasceu Eliaquim; a Eliaquim nasceu Azor;
verses.en_web: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.
verses.en_bbe: And Zerubbabel had Abiud; and Abiud had Eliakim; and Eliakim had Azor;

verses.en: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.pt: a Azor nasceu Sadoque; a Sadoque nasceu Aquim; a Aquim nasceu Eliúde;
verses.en_web: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.
verses.en_bbe: And Azor had Zadok; and Zadok had Achim; and Achim had Eliud;

verses.en: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.pt: a Eliúde nasceu Eleazar; a Eleazar nasceu Matã; a Matã nasceu Jacó;
verses.en_web: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And Eliud had Eleazar; and Eleazar had Matthan; and Matthan had Jacob;

verses.en: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.pt: e a Jacó nasceu José, marido de Maria, da qual nasceu JESUS, que se chama Cristo.
verses.en_web: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And the son of Jacob was Joseph the husband of Mary, who gave birth to Jesus, whose name is Christ.

verses.en: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.pt: De sorte que todas as gerações, desde Abraão até Davi, são catorze gerações; e desde Davi até a deportação para Babilônia, catorze gerações; e desde a deportação para Babilônia até o Cristo, catorze gerações.
verses.en_web: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.
verses.en_bbe: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the taking away to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the taking away to Babylon to the coming of Christ, fourteen generations.

verses.en: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Ora, o nascimento de Jesus Cristo foi assim: Estando Maria, sua mãe, desposada com José, antes de se ajuntarem, ela se achou ter concebido do Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was in this way: when his mother Mary was going to be married to Joseph, before they came together the discovery was made that she was with child by the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.pt: E como José, seu esposo, era justo, e não a queria infamar, intentou deixá-la secretamente.
verses.en_web: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph, her husband, being an upright man, and not desiring to make her a public example, had a mind to put her away privately.

verses.en: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: E, projetando ele isso, eis que em sonho lhe apareceu um anjo do Senhor, dizendo: José, filho de Davi, não temas receber a Maria, tua mulher, pois o que nela se gerou é do Espírito Santo;
verses.en_web: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: But when he was giving thought to these things, an angel of the Lord came to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, have no fear of taking Mary as your wife; because that which is in her body is of the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.pt: ela dará à luz um filho, a quem chamarás JESUS; porque ele salvará o seu povo dos seus pecados.
verses.en_web: She shall give birth to a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”
verses.en_bbe: And she will give birth to a son; and you will give him the name Jesus; for he will give his people salvation from their sins.

verses.en: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.pt: Ora, tudo isso aconteceu para que se cumprisse o que fora dito da parte do Senhor pelo profeta:
verses.en_web: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Now all this took place so that the word of the Lord by the prophet might come true,

verses.en: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.pt: Eis que a virgem conceberá e dará à luz um filho, o qual será chamado EMANUEL, que traduzido é: Deus conosco.
verses.en_web: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel”; which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
verses.en_bbe: See, the virgin will be with child, and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name Immanuel, that is, God with us.

verses.en: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.pt: E José, tendo despertado do sono, fez como o anjo do Senhor lhe ordenara, e recebeu sua mulher;
verses.en_web: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
verses.en_bbe: And Joseph did as the angel of the Lord had said to him, and took her as his wife;

verses.en: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
verses.pt: e não a conheceu enquanto ela não deu à luz um filho; e pôs-lhe o nome de JESUS.
verses.en_web: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: And he had no connection with her till she had given birth to a son; and he gave him the name Jesus.
